voice.summary: Nimbus & Pine sounds like a calm shop owner explaining a lamp by what it does for your evening. Product features are told as small comforts, with exact figures (40 hours, one touch) to keep the promise honest.
dos: Describe a feature by the moment it improves
Give exact numbers for battery, time and size
Write like a note on a gift tag
donts: Do not use gadget hype or 'smart' as a catch-all
Never hide a spec behind a vague adjective

taglines: A lamp you find in the dark
